decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems sits close to the firm's established hearing-care offer and uses its existing digital manufacturing and certified processes, so its incremental cost is low, slack in a growing industry lets it carry the product, and the limited website presence gives no sign of a shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The individual EARsleeve has its own page and is promoted for universal in-ear hearing systems, which shows management commitment, and it fits the firm's core earmold competence and the growing hearing-care market, so it likely meets aspirations and will be retained.

The vacuum thermoforming unit extends the firm's long-standing dental equipment line, is featured on its own page, and supports the integrated material-and-device workflow strategy, so dropping it would gain little and would risk lost system sales.
